name: veterinary_clinic_system_035_cs_waste_protocol_entry
instruction: Run the episode's controlled-substance waste event end to end, under the episode batch code (ops_meta.batch_code). The waste event is parameterized by three integer fields in ops_meta, so read them first: cs_waste_loc_idx selects the target location — take the distinct location_id values among pharmacy_inventory rows flagged is_controlled, sort them ascending, and pick the value at index cs_waste_loc_idx; cs_waste_drug_idx selects the item — among the is_controlled pharmacy_inventory rows at that location, sort the item_name values alphabetically and pick the row at index cs_waste_drug_idx (the selected item is always stocked at the selected location); the waste quantity in units is cs_waste_qty_tenths divided by 10.0 — it is an integer count of tenths of a unit, not a float and not a percent. The waste must be recorded as performed by a veterinarian assigned to the selected location and witnessed by a veterinary technician (vet_tech) assigned to the selected location — look them up in providers; any single veterinarian/vet-tech pair at that location is acceptable. (1) Append one controlled_substance_log row: item_name and location_id of the selected inventory row, action='waste', quantity=the waste quantity, performed_by and witnessed_by = the chosen providers' full_name values, occurred_at = the episode timestamp (episode_date at midnight UTC), notes='Protocol waste <batch_code>'. (2) Decrement the selected pharmacy_inventory row's quantity_on_hand by exactly the waste quantity — it may become fractional; only that one inventory row may change. (3) Append one audit_log row: actor = the performing veterinarian's full_name, actor_role='veterinarian', action='CS_WASTE_LOGGED', target_collection='controlled_substance_log', target_id = the new log row's id, batch_code = the batch code, details='Waste protocol <batch_code>: <quantity> units of <item_name> at location <location_id>', occurred_at = episode timestamp. (4) Push exactly one ops_reports row: report='waste_protocol', batch_code, item_name, location_id, quantity_wasted, inventory_after = the post-decrement quantity_on_hand, performed_by, witnessed_by, log_id = the new controlled_substance_log row's id. No other collection, inventory row, log row, or audit row may change.
_steps_note: par_steps and max_steps must be measured from a real gold.py run against a live container in the QC session (RL_ENV_HARDMODE_CODEGEN_PROMPT); intentionally null here — do not guess a round number.

success_criteria.summary: The selected controlled pharmacy_inventory row (derived from ops_meta loc/drug indexes over is_controlled rows) is decremented by cs_waste_qty_tenths/10.0 with float-exact math, all other inventory rows byte-identical; controlled_substance_log gains exactly one waste row with the derived item/location/quantity, a valid veterinarian+vet-tech pair at the selected location, notes keyed to batch_code, and the episode date; audit_log gains exactly one CS_WASTE_LOGGED row pointing at the new log row; ops_reports gains exactly one waste_protocol row whose inventory_after matches the live post-decrement quantity and whose log_id matches the new log row. Post-decrement quantity is asserted via two independent reads (REST query vs SQL). All seeded collections outside the blast radius are canary-checked byte-identical.

checks.expect: seed count + 1; new row fields exact; performed_by is a veterinarian and witnessed_by a vet_tech at the selected location (verified against providers)
selected row quantity_on_hand == seed - waste_qty (float tolerance); every other row byte-identical
post-decrement quantity_on_hand agrees between the REST read and an independent SQL SELECT
seed count + 1; new CS_WASTE_LOGGED row exact incl. batch_code and target_id = new log id
exactly one waste_protocol row for batch_code matching the live log row and live inventory

hazards: Existing waste rows already in controlled_substance_log must not be edited or reused: snapshot id 3 is action='waste' item_name='Ketamine' location_id='1' quantity=0.4, and id 11 is action='waste' item_name='Tramadol' location_id='2' quantity=0.5 patient_id='10'. A solution that updates an existing waste row instead of appending fails the seed+1 count and the byte-identity check on seeded rows.

Every controlled drug is stocked at BOTH locations 1 and 2 — e.g. Ketamine is inventory ids 39 (loc 1) and 40 (loc 2), both quantity_on_hand 3, reorder_level 4; Buprenorphine ids 35/36, Tramadol 37/38, Alprazolam 41/42. An agent that matches on item_name alone decrements two rows or the wrong location; only the row selected by the nonce indexes may change.

The non-controlled inventory rows are decoys: 'Rabies vaccine 1yr' (ids 1-2), 'DHPP vaccine' (3-4), 'FVRCP vaccine' (5-6), 'Bordetella vaccine' (7-8) and all supply rows are not is_controlled — the alphabetical selection must run over controlled rows only, or the index mapping lands on a non-controlled item.

Several seeded controlled_substance_log rows have witnessed_by equal to a garbage character or empty (ids 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 11) — an agent that copies a witness value from an existing row instead of looking up a real vet-tech at the location fails the role/location check.

cs_waste_qty_tenths is an integer 1-9 stored in ops_meta; an agent that pushes it as the quantity directly (e.g. 5 units instead of 0.5) or treats it as a percent produces a wildly wrong inventory decrement — the verifier compares float-exactly against seed - tenths/10.0.

audit_log has only 4 seeded rows and is append-only: a rerun that appends a second CS_WASTE_LOGGED row, or an agent that skips the audit row entirely, fails the seed+1 count. Likewise ops_reports is not one of the 24 seeded collections (absent from seed_snapshot.json) — the agent must create it blind; a solution that queries it first for schema and gives up writes nothing.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: v1's single fixed waste row is upgraded to a per-episode randomized waste event (drug index, location index, and tenths-of-a-unit quantity all come from ops_meta) whose execution must atomically touch four collections: log append, float inventory decrement, audit append keyed by the new row id, and a report row reconciled against live post-mutation state. Role/location validation of the staff pair and the seeded garbage-witness decoys force real provider lookups.
